decision.bounded_question: Useful separately supervised member graph-order allocations under a paid common-bank budget beyond capable same-bank nonlinear, feature-only/all-layer BE, and independent ensemble controls. Already posed in reused reports; not relabeled as a new gap.
decision.new_local_contribution: Analytic witness and an exact qualified cached-token/interpolation measurement statement, without novelty claim.

papers.title: $β$-GNN: A Robust Ensemble Approach Against Graph Structure Perturbation
papers.operation: Separate GNN and feature-only MLP with learned scalar output blending.
papers.reuse_or_counterargument: Competent graph-free/MLP control and topology-sensitivity restraint.
papers.limits: Not shared BE/order factors or an intermember response penalty; different predictions are not sufficient for a nonzero loss derivative in vector outputs. Severity estimator/calibration interpretation unaudited.

papers.title: COMBINEX: A Unified Counterfactual Explainer for Graph Neural Networks via Node Feature and Structural Perturbations
papers.operation: Fixed pretrained GNN; joint feature/topology perturbation variables with target-flip and minimal-change losses.
papers.reuse_or_counterargument: Feature versus graph counterfactual interventions are established.
papers.limits: Classification flips are not label-preserving utility. Complete algorithm tables and result/proof claims unaudited.

papers.title: Parameter-Free Structural-Diversity Message Passing for Graph Neural Networks
papers.operation: Neighborhood grouping, within-group mean, root concatenation, cross-group max and JK fusion.
papers.reuse_or_counterargument: Structural diversity can concern neighborhood organization rather than predictive-member diversity.
papers.limits: Feature pseudo-groups use structurally derived group count/initial grouping in inspected formulation; no genuinely graph-free claim. Proof/results/algorithm certification absent.

papers.title: SPGCL: Simple yet Powerful Graph Contrastive Learning via SVD-Guided Structural Perturbation
papers.operation: Edge removal plus SVD-guided sparse edge recovery/addition; shared encoder, node InfoNCE and global embedding Gram consistency plus task CE.
papers.reuse_or_counterargument: Controlled structural perturbation and minimizing nuisance sensitivity are prior.
papers.limits: No certified label preservation, inference-cost transfer, or useful-member-hypothesis guarantee; SVD empirical/runtime claims unaudited.

papers.title: Beyond the Laplacian: Interpolated Spectral Augmentation for Graph Neural Networks
papers.operation: Eigenvector feature augmentation using interpolated Laplacian M(a,b)=aD-bA, with symmetry-aware preprocessing.
papers.reuse_or_counterargument: Interpolation and spectral feature augmentation are established; identity shifts preserve eigenspaces.
papers.limits: Not the same intervention as (1-t)P+tI response probing; inspected lemma is a statement, not proof certification. No ensemble utility conclusion.

papers.title: Rethinking Spectral Augmentation for Contrast-based Graph Self-Supervised Learning
papers.operation: DropEdge/AddEdge within contrast-based graph SSL; shallow-encoder counterargument to complex spectral views.
papers.reuse_or_counterargument: Need competent simple graph-perturbation controls and paid work.
papers.limits: Main theorem and cost/optimality prose not independently proved or empirically audited. Eigensolver cost does not imply cached polynomial probes require eigensolvers.

papers.title: Spectral Augmentations for Graph Contrastive Learning
papers.operation: Spectral crops, frequency-component reordering using existing eigenbasis, local-global alignment and similarity filtering.
papers.reuse_or_counterargument: Changing views using retained spectral information without repeated decomposition and augmentation quality filtering are prior.
papers.limits: No label-preserving ensemble guarantee. Displayed polynomial-sum indexing inconsistencies are not silently corrected into certified formula; reuse claim comes from method prose.

important_reused_corrections.DICE: Conditional feature MI is invariant to invertible feature transforms; not hidden cosine repulsion.
important_reused_corrections.FoRDE: Current corrected author-code source uses raw selected logit and full-X gradient; stale log-probability note superseded.
important_reused_corrections.existing_adapter: Saved per-token polynomial MLP BE R/S sites already order indexed; this alone cannot distinguish a new architecture.
important_reused_corrections.old_tangent_initializer: Not used as positive evidence; parent reported negligible Squirrel contrast and worse Photo mean than warm_copy pending audit.

falsifiers: No additional effect beyond competent same-bank nonlinear forward-capacity control.
No pooled NLL/utility improvement at comparable member competence despite response differences.
Advantage disappears under matched parameter, graph-work, dense-head, memory or selection budget.
Existing all-layer per-token BE reproduces the proposed allocation effect.
Useful difference requires evolving private nonlinear graph trajectories, invalidating claimed one-bank reuse.
access_limit: GENN and AAAI counterfactual-regularization primaries unread through attempted routes. Failed access and zero-entry discovery are not negative evidence.
